newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares tumble on late selling.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares tumble on late selling.

text.p: Austrian shares took a last- minute tumble on Wednesday after a generally buoyant session, traders said.
"It doesn't reflect the market at all," said one. "It was just someone trying to bring the market down to cover their positions," he added.

The ATX blue chip index closed down 14,98 points or 1.38 percent at 1,073.54. Just prior to the close the index was hovering around 1,089, having hit an intraday high of 1,090.42 earlier in the session.
Some traders saw Tuesday's 10-week closing high of 1,089 points as unsustainable, but most saw the market rebounding to today's highs on Thursday.
"The market will definitely go back up tomorrow," one said.
At the close of trade eight ATX shares were up, 11 down, and two unchanged.
The leading gainer was luxury hosiery maker Wolford, climbing 85 schillings to 1,510.
Among the stocks that saw heavy last-minute selling were steelmaker VA Stahl, industrial group OMV and insurer EA Generali.
VA Stahl was the leading decliner, down 20 schillings or 5.41 percent at 350. OMV and EA Generali lost 52.5 schillings and 140 schillings to end at 1,060.5 and 3,010 respectively.
The October ATX future climbed 3.8 points to 1,085.6, ahead of the futures and options expiry on Friday.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index lost 4.26 points or 1.03 percent to end at 411.33
